title: Two calls waiting on you
intro: The tracker's **Waiting on Ian** rows, as of master `47513544`. Each says what it decides and what happens if it stays open.

questions.title: What may a sweep of leftover save files remove?
context: A save writes the new bytes to a hidden staging file beside the document, then renames it over the original. If Marxy is killed between the two, the staging file stays: `.<name>.marxy-tmp-<pid>-<attempt>-<nanos>`, in the user's own folder.
Nothing removes these today. A sweep would delete files in folders Marxy does not own, so it needs a rule for which ones.

head: Folder after a crash mid-save
Size
What it is
rows: the new bytes that never landed

visual.caption: What a reader finds today: the document is safe; the staging file is the unsaved edit

choices.label: Never sweep
choices.detail: Leftovers stay until someone deletes them. Nothing outside the document is ever removed.

choices.label: Only this run's own leftovers
choices.detail: A staging name carrying a process id that is no longer running, in a folder this run saved to. Removes nothing another program made.

choices.label: Any Marxy staging file older than an age
choices.detail: Any `.marxy-tmp-` name in a folder Marxy opens, once old enough.

choices.label: Show them and let the reader decide
choices.detail: A notice on the folder: a leftover save, with Delete and Restore.
choices.specify: Should Restore put the unsaved bytes back as the document?

questions.default: Never sweep: the row stays here and leftovers accumulate.

questions.title: Idle typesetting slice: 24 ms or 40 ms?
context: While the reader is idle, the typesetter sets paragraphs in slices. A bigger slice finishes a long page sooner but holds the main thread longer, so a frame drawn mid-slice is slower.
Measured on a 1 MB page under the same load. The setting is one constant.

visual.caption: Time to set the whole 1 MB page (shorter is better)
Worst frame at rest while setting (shorter is better)

choices.label: Keep 24 ms
choices.detail: Smoother at rest; the full page takes 86 s.

choices.label: Move to 40 ms
choices.detail: The full page in 57 s; frames at rest up to 171 ms.

choices.label: Make it a setting
choices.detail: A Settings row; 24 ms by default.
choices.specify: What should the row be called?

questions.default: Keep 24 ms and remove the row.
